Actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna involved in film projects

Actors Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna are reportedly involved in separate film projects. Deverakonda's film, titled Ranabaali, has completed the background score for its first half. Mandanna is rumored to be portraying M.S. Subbulakshmi in a biopic, with Anirudh Ravichander attached as composer for this project.
